title: Boiler registration
applicability_conditions: BOILER_EXISTING := F-BLR-07 == 'REGISTERED_UNDER_1923_ACT' -> deemed registered (s.45(2)(f)); certificate continues until date shown unless cancelled (s.45(2)(g))

title: BOILER_CERT_CEASES
applicability_conditions: BOILER_CERT_CEASES := expiry OR accident OR move (except vertical <20 m2 HS / portable / vehicular) OR structural alteration (save s.17) OR CI direction on steam-pipe alteration OR prohibition order -> renewal application (s.13(3)); continued use pending decision only if applied before expiry (s.15)

applicability_conditions: ISMW := F-LAB-08 >= 10 (inter-State migrant workers on any day of preceding 12 months)
notes: MH procedure under State rules DRAFT; portal service cites ISMW Act 1979 (PORTAL_LEGACY)

applicability_conditions: BOCW := F-LAB-05 >= 10 AND construction NOT excluded by s.2(1)(h) ; exclusion for construction 'related to factory' -> UNKNOWN for construction of a new factory (interpretation)

title: CMVR_CONSIGNOR
applicability_conditions: CMVR_CONSIGNOR := F-TRN-01 == TRUE (unit consigns Table III dangerous/hazardous goods by road) -> consignor duties r.131 (valid registration of carriage, safety/first-aid equipment and antidotes, full information to transporter, trained driver)

title: EWASTE_BULK
applicability_conditions: EWASTE_BULK := F-EEE-01 >= 1000 (units of Schedule-I EEE used at any point in the FY) -> hand over e-waste only to registered producer/refurbisher/recycler (r.8)

title: ODS_REG
applicability_conditions: ODS_REG := F-ODS-01 == TRUE (enterprise uses an ODS in a Schedule IV activity) -> registration (r.8, Form 11) ; producer (r.3) / seller (r.6) branches if applicable ; UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
notes: Amendments after India Code copy not checked

title: Hazardous waste authorisation (Form 1 -> Form 2)
applicability_conditions: HW_SCH2_TEST := for a waste not listed in Sch I: hazardous if any Sch II characteristic met (Class A TCLP > limit; Class B > limit; C1 flash point < 60 C; C2 pH <= 2 or >= 12.5 or corrosion > 6.35 mm/yr at 55 C; C3 reactive) ; without lab data -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA
notes: Never infer a waste code; post-2016 Schedule II amendments UNK-034

title: MH_GW_DEEP_WELL_PROHIBITION
applicability_conditions: MH_GW_DEEP_WELL_PROHIBITION := IF F-GW-02 > 60 m AND purpose IN {agriculture, industry} AND F-GW-03 (village in MWRRA 2015 annexure of 80 watersheds) == TRUE THEN APPLIES (prohibited; drinking-water exception via Sub-Divisional Officer) ; F-GW-03 FALSE -> DOES_NOT_APPLY for this order only ; any inp

title: MATHADI
applicability_conditions: MATHADI := F-LOC-19 (locality covered by an area/employment notification) AND F-LAB-10 (engages workers in a scheduled employment e.g. loading/unloading of chemical products) -> registration under applicable Board scheme ; UNKNOWN -> CONDITIONAL

title: Final fire NOC (non-MIDC)
applicability_conditions: FINAL_FIRE_APPROVAL_RENEWAL := IF F-FIR-20 == TRUE THEN CONDITIONAL (renewal per that Act/Rule) ELSE IF F-FIR-20 == FALSE THEN DOES_NOT_APPLY ELSE UNKNOWN ; Form B (Jan/Jul) always evaluated separately (FR-04)
notes: Unresolved item is the sector-specific exception (FR-03), not the general principle

applicability_conditions: PESO_PETROLEUM_LICENCE_RENEWAL := IF unit holds Petroleum Rules licence (not Form III/XVII) THEN renewal before 31 Dec of expiry year (validity max 3 y) ; licence held UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
dependencies: DOC-008 (Rule 144 NOC);District Authority NOC (r.144);Plan approval (r.131) for Forms XIV/XV/XVI
notes: SECTOR_SPECIFIC_CERTIFICATE; not a fire-approval renewal

title: Gas cylinder storage licence (Form F)
applicability_conditions: PESO_GCR_LICENCE_RENEWAL := IF unit holds Form E/F/G licence THEN renewal before 30 Sept of expiry year (validity max 10 y) ; UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
notes: SECTOR_SPECIFIC_CERTIFICATE

title: SMPV(U) licence (LS-1A) and prior approval
applicability_conditions: PESO_SMPV_LICENCE_RENEWAL := IF unit holds LS-1A/LS-1B licence THEN renewal before 30 Sept of expiry year (validity max 5 y) ; UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN
notes: SECTOR_SPECIFIC_CERTIFICATE

applicability_conditions: SMPV_DA_NOC := IF application_date < 2026-06-05 AND new LS-1A/LS-1B licence AND gas NOT (non-toxic AND non-flammable) THEN APPLIES (District Authority NOC, r.47) ; IF application_date >= 2026-06-05 THEN DOES_NOT_APPLY (r.47 omitted) ; application_date UNKNOWN -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA
notes: Temporal rule; treatment of applications pending on 05-06-2026 not stated -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA for those

title: Gas cylinder storage licence (Form F)
applicability_conditions: GCR_DA_NOC := IF Form F licence for storage for SALE/TRADING (not own use) and not part of a filling plant, OR Form G (CNG) THEN APPLIES ; own-use Form F -> DOES_NOT_APPLY ; purpose UNKNOWN -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA
notes: r.48(3)(b) wording extended by 2026 amendment ('or other flammable gases')

applicability_conditions: PLANNING_ZONE_PERMISSIBILITY := IF any of F-LOC-05 planning_authority, F-PLN-02 zone, F-PLN-03 proposed_use, F-PLN-04 existing_use is UNKNOWN THEN INSUFFICIENT_DATA ; ELSE CONDITIONAL (AUTHORITY_SITE_DEPENDENT: permissibility and change of use decided by the planning authority under its DP/RP and UD
